output.sql:
SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
output.explanation: Revenue is defined by fct_orders.is_revenue = true, and the amount is net_revenue. I filtered to orders dated in calendar 2025, summed net_revenue per customer, and joined dim_customers for the company name. I grouped by customer_id as well as company_name so two customers with the same name are not merged. The results are the top five by revenue, descending. I did not use dim_customers.lifetime_net_revenue because it covers all time, not 2025.
